messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: paging oncall: OIDC token introspection failing for tenant 'CrescentAI' in private VPC (ap-southeast-1). Elevated 401/502s since ~02:07 UTC. Please ack.
Ava Li: ack. I'm oncall. Any recent DNS/issuer changes? @Customer Ops @DNS Ops
Customer Ops: CrescentAI ticket #9921: they changed their OIDC issuer hostname to `auth.crescentai.app` and updated DNS CNAME at 02:03 UTC. They expected the jwks endpoint to be served from the same host.
Ben Park: grabbing auth-bridge and jwks-fetch logs.
Ben Park: logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:06:58Z bridge[auth]: jwks_fetch tenant=crescentai url=https://old-issuer.crescentai.net/.well-known/jwks.json status=200 content-type=text/html
2026-03-15T02:06:58Z bridge[auth]: token_introspect 502 tenant=crescentai reason=jwks_parse_error
2026-03-15T02:07:02Z bridge[auth]: jwks_fetch tenant=crescentai url=https://auth.crescentai.app/.well-known/jwks.json status=404
```
Ava Li: 200 with text/html looks like DNS still pointing to a web server serving default page (proxy misconfig). 404 from new host too. That explains parse errors and 502s.
Theo Nguyen: do we have last-known JWKS snapshot for that tenant? We backup jwks per tenant to s3.
Theo Nguyen: s3://redwood-tenant-jwks/crescentai/2026-03-15T01:58:12.jwks.json exists (pre-change).
Mar\u00eda G\u00f3mez: mitigation options: 1) instruct customer to restore proper jwks endpoint and DNS; 2) temporarily hot-upload their JWKS into tenant keystore so bridge validates tokens without fetching; 3) point tenant issuer override to alternate working endpoint if provided. Preferred: hot-upload from backup to restore service quickly.
Customer Ops: CrescentAI can confirm jwks JSON content; they authorize Redwood to upload their last-known jwks for up to 1 hour while they fix DNS.
Ava Li: executing hot-upload. Procedure (internal):
```
# upload jwks for tenant crescentai
redwoodctl jwks set --tenant crescentai --jwks-file ./crescentai-backup.jwks.json --ttl 3600
# reload auth bridge for tenant
redwoodctl bridge reload --tenant crescentai
```
Deploy Bot: job started: jwks-set (run id: jwks-9912).
Deploy Bot: job success: jwks-set (run id: jwks-9912)
Ava Li: reload triggered. Watching logs.
Ava Li: post-patch logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:43Z bridge[auth]: jwks_loaded tenant=crescentai keys=3 source=keystore
2026-03-15T02:12:44Z bridge[auth]: token_introspect 200 tenant=crescentai sub=svc-77
2026-03-15T02:12:45Z bridge[auth]: token_introspect 200 tenant=crescentai sub=web-12
```
Ava Li: auth traffic recovered to baseline. Customer Ops: please confirm on your side.
Customer Ops: CrescentAI confirms downstream success and decreased errors. They will revert DNS back to correct host configuration now.
DNS Ops: we see the CNAME mispointed to a static hosting provider that served an index.html. They will roll back the CNAME to the previous target; change propagated by 02:18 UTC.
Ben Park: root cause: customer rotated/changed issuer hostname and DNS pointed to wrong host that did not serve JWKS, causing our jwks fetch to return HTML/404 and bridge to fail token validation. Secondary cause: our bridge replaced cached JWKS when fetch returned successful HTTP 200, but didn't validate content-type or JSON shape strictly enough, which masked the issue until token parsing failed.
Mar\u00eda G\u00f3mez: follow-ups and mitigations:
- Add content-type and JSON schema validation for remote JWKS before replacing cached set (owner: Ben)
- Add a merge/fallback policy: if new JWKS fetch fails schema checks, continue using last-good JWKS for configurable grace period (owner: Theo)
- Add alert rule for repeated 4xx/5xx jwks_fetch events per tenant (owner: Mar\u00eda)
- Update onboarding docs to require JWKS smoke test after DNS changes (owner: Customer Ops)
Raj Patel: impact: outage window ~02:07 - 02:12 (5m) of elevated 502/401 for CrescentAI token introspection. Customer reported increased signin and API failures. No cross-tenant impact.
Ava Li: handing off to Ben for the code PRs. I'll add timeline to PMO and draft the postmortem. Handoff in 30m.
SRE Pager: acknowledged handoff and added incident to rotation notes.
Incident Bot: incident mitigated (hot-uploaded JWKS + customer DNS rollback) at 02:12 UTC. Please file follow-ups and link PMO postmortem.
Raj Patel: postmortem draft link: https://redwood-internal/pmo/incidents/2950002222-crescentai-issuer-dns-jwks (will update with timeline and owners).
Customer Ops: CrescentAI requested a short playbook and a confirmation webhook when we switch to keystore JWKS (they want audit). We'll add it to the follow-ups.
Ava Li: closing active ops at 02:40 UTC. If errors reappear escalate to SEV2. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
